headline: Legacy Law Offices acts on Himalaya Nutravedics IPO

detail: Himalaya Nutravedics Limited has completed its Initial Public Offering on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME platform for a book-built offer for an entirely fresh issue of 24,99,600 shares, with an offer size of ₹26.5 crore. Legacy Law Offices advised Himalaya Nutravedics as well as the Book Running Lead Manager, Nirbhay Capital Private Limited, on this SME IPO. The transaction team comprised of Priya Kataria (Associate Partner), Naman Anand (Counsel), and Associates Anushka Indurkar and Yukti Goel. Surbhi Narang (Partner) provided strategic inputs.
